question: Who among the following Indian Music composers won a Grammy award in the year 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ricky Kej.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ricky Kej:-**

 
 
• He is an Indian music composer who won the Grammy Award for Best New Age Album in the year 2015 for his album "Winds of Samsara". 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MM Keeravani:-**

 
 
• He is a popular Indian music composer who has won several awards for his work in Telugu cinema.
 
• He is known for composing music for films like Baahubali and Magadheera.
 
 
 
• **Aby Tom Cyriac:-**
 
 
• He is a relatively unknown music composer from Kerala who has composed music for a few Malayalam films.
 
 
 
• **AR Rahman:-**
 
 
• He is a legendary Indian music composer who has won several awards including Oscars, Grammys and BAFTAs.
 
• He is known for his work in films like Slumdog Millionaire, Roja and Dil Se.
